Record notes

Twenty-one software workflows with complete native, Go, GitHub, local pipeline, MCP and debugging procedures.

Version 0.2.2 includes 21 complete skill procedures. Complete source methods, query/scaffolding helpers and synthetic fixtures; authorized Go corpus and platform providers supplied separately.

Requirements: Host coding tools; Runtime named by the selected workflow.

License scope: AGPL-3.0-only AND CC-BY-SA-4.0; retained upstream licenses as scoped in LICENSE-SCOPE.json. Read the packaged notices and provenance before reuse.

Install with codex plugin add development-studio@working-tools after adding JonathanKHobson/working-tools-plugins, or the documented Claude Code marketplace path. Installation and tested compatibility.

This ZIP has its portable manifest at the root, preserves all referenced package files. This release includes a separate per-file hash inventory. Built from fa4f68d5883a99971983ed9a7d874bc6e8993ec6. SHA-256: 600ad7058b8b9e1598d51c17718da07da8ba19767f940c70eceaed93a72e0e41.

Native marketplace distribution is separate from official OpenAI Plugin Directory publication. External provider access remains a prerequisite.
